lines: Not ten. Not a whole new life. *One.*
#Pick the one thing that would change the *most* if you did it every day.
A workout. Ten pages. Saving a little. Waking up a little *earlier.*
Make it small enough to do on your *worst* day.
Mark it on a calendar. Don't break the *chain.*
One slip is an accident. Two is the start of a new *habit.*
#By the end of the month, you won't just have a habit.
Proof that you're not who you used to *be.*
end: Comment your habit and start today.
